Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000990" [decision]: The billing API is owned by the Ember team as of 2026-01-12, having moved from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000983" [constraint]: As of 2025-12-29, the auth gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000965" [decision]: The product catalog is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-12-19, having moved from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000959" [decision]: As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000900": On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team noticed that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000892": As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka holds the Cinder pager, taking over from Diego, who is leaving the team.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000886": As of 2025-11-27, Diego is on the Ember team, having left Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000812": On 2025-11-04 the Ember team saw that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it because it is not their service.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000795": As of 2025-10-16, the Cinder team sits on the third floor.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000780" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, ownership of the ledger service transferred to Cinder from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000776": As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder instead of the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000722" [decision]: The job scheduler was owned by the Dune team from 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team, until ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000716" [decision]: As of 2025-09-05, the Dune team still owned the job scheduler; ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000712": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings Cinder instead of the Dune team.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000703": The authentication gateway is owned by Cinder as of 2025-09-16, having moved from the Ember team.  (about: Cinder, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000686": Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager as of 2025-09-05, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder, Diego)
- memory_id "1000674": On 2025-09-03 the Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000610": During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: authentication gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000514": The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000439": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, taking over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000409" [decision]: Cinder adopted trunk-based development.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000404": On 2025-05-14 the Cinder team observed that webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhooks)
- memory_id "1000364": As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000253": The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder)
Existing entity names: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team, auth gateway, Cinder, product catalog, Boreal team, Yuki Tanaka, Diego, ledger service, Dune team, job scheduler, authentication gateway, INC-2025-017, notifier, INC-2025-011, indexer, webhooks, feature-flags
